used_propositions: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change during the rebrand.
Registry record HRB 88421 lists the registered company name as Oakfield Logistik GmbH, located in Germany, with status active.
support_claim: The billing referent Oakfield Logistik GmbH and registry referent HRB 88421 denote the same legal entity, as the register number remained unchanged through the 2023 rebrand and the registry record lists that name for HRB 88421.
